_doc.purpose: Closed vocabulary for the catalog `license` field, plus what each value implies. Drives four checks in validate.mjs: the vocabulary check, the license/license_spdx cross-check, the 'SPDX is fillable but absent' check, and the attribution-consistency check. Adding a license to the catalog means adding it here first.
_doc.spdx: The one SPDX identifier this license value maps to, or null when it maps to none. A null with `spdx_ambiguous` set means an identifier exists but the recorded value does not say which one, so it must not be guessed.
_doc.attribution: required = credit the author in your product; the entry needs attribution_required true, or a stated waiver in the body. notice = carry the license/copyright file with what you redistribute, which is not a product credit, so attribution_required false is normal. none = nothing owed. any = varies per file, do not check.

public-domain.note: A copyright status, not an instrument. Has no SPDX identifier. Use CC0 only when the publisher actually applied the CC0 waiver, and Unlicense only when the project ships the Unlicense text.

GPL-2.0.spdx_ambiguous: SPDX deprecated the bare identifier. The project is either GPL-2.0-only or GPL-2.0-or-later and this value does not say which. Read the project's own statement, then record the precise license value instead of this one.

GPL-3.0.spdx_ambiguous: SPDX deprecated the bare identifier. The project is either GPL-3.0-only or GPL-3.0-or-later and this value does not say which. Read the project's own statement, then record the precise license value instead of this one.

SIL OFL.note: OFL obliges you to carry the copyright notice and license with the font files you redistribute, including embedded ones. It does not oblige a credits-screen line, which is why font entries set attribution_required false. See docs/licenses.md.

CC-BY.spdx_ambiguous: Unversioned. Record CC-BY-3.0 or CC-BY-4.0 once the source states the version.

custom.note: Publisher's own terms. The entry body must say what they actually grant.

varies.note: Aggregators where the license is per file. Not a blanket grant.

unknown.note: Source does not state it plainly. Pairs with status: needs-review.

families._doc: Groups for the site's Licence filter. Every license value above belongs to exactly one family (lib.test.mjs checks this).
